name: Yamaha CP1
description: Yamaha CP1 stage piano: every parameter change table of its data list (System, the Performance with its two layers and four Master Keyboard zones), identity, and Pull from the Performance edit buffer.

Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 0C <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
Identity: the reply the data list prints, F0 7E 7F 06 02 43 00 41 3B 06 00 00 00 01 F7.
Left out, the headers and footers of the bulk dumps, not settings: BULK CONTROL.

parameters.name: Master Tune
parameters.description: 4 bytes: 1st bit 3-0 : bit 15-12 2nd bit 3-0 : bit 11-8 3rd bit 3-0 : bit 7-4 : 4th bit 3-0 bit 3-0. Printed: -102.4 – +102.3 [cent]. MIDI Master Tuning.

parameters.name: Performance Name
parameters.description: 10 characters, one per address from 30 00 00, 32..126 (ASCII). Read from the bulk dump; not written, since a parameter change carries one character.
